title: We're hiring
brief:
An issue of Orbit's newsletter, The Orbit Dispatch, made with Orbit's newsletter kit (see CLAUDE.md for its rules).

- Preview text: "Six roles open on the Orbit team."
- Heading: "We're hiring"
- Intro: "Orbit is growing, and we'd like you to grow it with us."
- Two stories, one after the other. Each is an image, a title, a sentence and a button:
  - Image https://assets.orbit.dev/img/orbit-app.png (1200×700 file), alt text "Orbit's product team at work". Title "Open roles". Text "Engineering, design and support, remote or in San Francisco.". Button "See open roles" to https://orbit.dev/careers?utm_source=newsletter.
  - Image https://assets.orbit.dev/img/event-hero.png (1200×600 file), alt text "The Orbit team at the summit". Title "Meet the team". Text "Who we are, how we work and what we're building next.". Button "Meet the team" to https://orbit.dev/team?utm_source=newsletter.
- Orbit's header (the logo) and footer (the address, and the unsubscribe link) are the kit's: use them as they are.
